tithi.name: Krishna Panchami
tithi.description: Favorable for family harmony, artistic pursuits, and propitiating ancestral and serpent deities.

Mesha.summary: Focus on domestic peace and emotional stability as the Moon graces your fourth house.
Mesha.general: A contemplative day that invites you to seek balance between inner desires and domestic duties. Ground your energy to avoid momentary restless feelings.
Mesha.career: Collaborative professional matters require tact and patience rather than aggressive initiative. A calm, measured response will earn you respect from seniors.
Mesha.finance: Real estate, home renovation, or comfort purchases could come into view. Maintain a structured budget before committing to substantial property expenditures.
Mesha.relationships: Open-hearted discussions with family will resolve long-standing domestic misunderstandings. Offer your presence and attentive ear to your mother or maternal elders.
Mesha.health: Watch out for mild chest heaviness, acidity, or emotional fatigue today. Stay hydrated and practice deep abdominal breathing exercises.
Mesha.remedy: Offer white flowers or unboiled milk to a Shiva Lingam in the morning.

Vrishabha.summary: Courage and initiative yield fruitful outcomes in communication and networking.
Vrishabha.general: Your self-confidence rises today, allowing you to articulate ideas with clarity and charm. Short-distance travel or productive correspondence brings positive returns.
Vrishabha.career: Marketing, writing, sales, and cross-team collaborations will flourish remarkably. Your proactive problem-solving attitude inspires your colleagues.
Vrishabha.finance: Financial prospects look promising through secondary income streams and creative initiatives. Timely decisions will yield steady long-term security.
Vrishabha.relationships: Bonds with younger siblings and neighbors receive warmth and mutual appreciation. Expressing gratitude to your partner strengthens the emotional foundation.
Vrishabha.health: Vitality is robust and physical endurance remains high throughout the day. Channel extra vitality into light cardio or an evening jog.
Vrishabha.remedy: Chant 'Om Shukraya Namaha' 21 times and apply fragrant sandalwood paste on your forehead.

Mithuna.summary: Prosperity and constructive speech enrich your personal and financial domain.
Mithuna.general: The Moon highlights your house of wealth and family resources, bringing contentment. Your eloquent articulation will naturally win over skeptics.
Mithuna.career: Financial discussions, client negotiations, and resource planning go exceptionally well. Expect positive news regarding pending dues or institutional support.
Mithuna.finance: A day marked by solid savings growth and prudent asset management. Avoid impulsive luxury shopping to keep your balance sheet pristine.
Mithuna.relationships: Family meals and sweet verbal exchanges create joyous domestic harmony. Cherish heartfelt discussions with your partner about future family goals.
Mithuna.health: Pay moderate attention to oral hygiene and throat comfort. Savor warm herbal tea or spiced milk before retiring at night.
Mithuna.remedy: Feed green fodder or fresh spinach to a cow during daylight hours.

Karka.summary: Emotional renewal and self-discovery empower your personal presence today.
Karka.general: With the Moon transiting your own sign, intuitive wisdom and personal magnetic charm shine bright. Trust your inner compass to guide crucial life choices.
Karka.career: You step into leadership effortlessly as your creative instincts align with practical work. Colleagues admire your empathetic yet authoritative decision-making.
Karka.finance: Personal investments in wellness, skills, and image development will prove worthwhile. Financial inflow remains balanced and well-regulated.
Karka.relationships: Your warmth draws loved ones closer, fostering deep emotional intimacy. Singles may attract someone who resonates deeply with their emotional wavelength.
Karka.health: General health is vibrant, though emotional sensitivity might peak periodically. Spend time near tranquil water bodies or engage in calming meditation.
Karka.remedy: Drink water from a silver cup and respect the blessings of your mother.

Simha.summary: Retreat inward, balance expenditures, and nurture spiritual peace.
Simha.general: A day designed for spiritual introspection, rest, and releasing unnecessary anxieties. Step back from aggressive public activities to recharge your internal batteries.
Simha.career: Work behind the scenes or research-oriented assignments will yield the greatest productivity. Avoid entering into debates with bureaucratic authorities.
Simha.finance: Keep a tight rein on overseas or spontaneous lifestyle expenses. Careful review of ongoing subscription and household bills is recommended.
Simha.relationships: Misunderstandings could arise if words are misinterpreted through emotional bias. Practice compassionate listening and give loved ones adequate personal space.
Simha.health: Ensure adequate rest to avoid eye strain, sleep disruptions, or physical exhaustion. Dim screens an hour before bed and practice guided meditation.
Simha.remedy: Offer water mixed with a pinch of red kumkum to the rising Sun.

Kanya.summary: Gains through network circles and fulfilled aspirations elevate your spirits.
Kanya.general: The 11th house transit heralds fruitful interactions, new allies, and fulfillment of plans. Your pragmatic strategy merges beautifully with community support.
Kanya.career: Projects achieve significant milestones, receiving praise from mentors and peers. New avenues for business expansion or institutional advancement emerge.
Kanya.finance: A highly auspicious day for wealth accumulation, profits, and settlement of gains. Previous investments begin displaying healthy, reassuring yields.
Kanya.relationships: Social gatherings bring memorable reunions and cheerful companionship with friends. Romantic partners share dreams about collective long-term prosperity.
Kanya.health: Vitality is elevated, offering high stamina and a positive mental outlook. Keep up your active lifestyle with wholesome, nutrient-dense nutrition.
Kanya.remedy: Donate green vegetables or moong lentils to a needy person.

Tula.summary: Professional accomplishments take center stage as your reputation expands.
Tula.general: Public recognition, career growth, and purposeful actions define your day. Your innate sense of diplomacy makes you an indispensable leader.
Tula.career: Key stakeholders look to you for creative solutions in high-stakes environments. Professional endeavors gain swift momentum under your steady guidance.
Tula.finance: Remuneration reviews or new profitable commercial contracts appear favorable. Balance your accounts with an eye toward sustainable business reinvestment.
Tula.relationships: Balancing high workload with relationship commitments is essential today. Reassure your spouse with affectionate messages throughout your busy schedule.
Tula.health: Maintain posture awareness and avoid prolonged periods of seated work. Take gentle stretch breaks to protect your lower back and shoulders.
Tula.remedy: Light a fragrant ghee lamp in front of Goddess Lakshmi this evening.

Vrischika.summary: Fortunate tides support higher learning, philosophical pursuits, and auspicious voyages.
Vrischika.general: A spiritual and fortunate wave flows through your life as the Moon enters your 9th house. Obstacles dissolve smoothly through divine grace and optimism.
Vrischika.career: Academic pursuits, legal resolutions, and long-range strategies will thrive. Counsel from a trusted mentor or advisor brings transformative clarity.
Vrischika.finance: Financial fortune smiles upon ethical investments and publishing or teaching avenues. Long-term fiscal plans gain remarkable stability today.
Vrischika.relationships: Meaningful conversations strengthen your spiritual bond with your life companion. Express heartfelt reverence toward your elders and spiritual guides.
Vrischika.health: Overall health is revitalized with enhanced mental serenity and inner peace. Outdoor walks in nature will elevate your spiritual and physical energy.
Vrischika.remedy: Apply a subtle tilak of saffron or yellow sandalwood on your forehead.

Dhanu.summary: Navigate deep transformations with patience, intuition, and mindfulness.
Dhanu.general: The Moon in the eighth house calls for caution, emotional composure, and inner fortitude. Avoid rushing decisions and delve into esoteric or reflective practices.
Dhanu.career: Handle sudden shifts in workplace deadlines with calm, methodical persistence. Refrain from getting involved in corporate politics or unverified rumors.
Dhanu.finance: Refrain from taking uncalculated risks, speculative trading, or impulsive lending. Double-check all financial paperwork and insurance clauses thoroughly.
Dhanu.relationships: Sensitive conversations need extreme gentleness to avoid misunderstanding. Honesty and emotional transparency will heal hidden relationship anxieties.
Dhanu.health: Pay attention to digestive sensitivity and manage stress-induced fatigue. Opt for easily digestible, warm meals and avoid heavy street food.
Dhanu.remedy: Chant the Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra 11 times with devotional focus.

Makara.summary: Partnerships, mutual cooperation, and public relations bring delightful rewards.
Makara.general: Harmony in one-on-one relationships is highlighted as the Moon occupies your opposite house. Harmonizing contrasting viewpoints brings mutually enriching solutions.
Makara.career: Business partnerships and joint ventures experience constructive discussions. Your reliability and diplomatic approach make a lasting impression on clients.
Makara.finance: Collaborative business ventures and partner-led investments promise steady gains. Review legal contracts mutually before final execution.
Makara.relationships: A wonderfully romantic and bonding day with your spouse or romantic interest. Meaningful mutual gestures will rekindle warmth and companionship.
Makara.health: Physical health remains well-balanced and stable throughout the day. Maintain adequate hydration and support kidney health with herbal infusions.
Makara.remedy: Offer white sweetmeats (kheer) to young girls or elders with respect.

Kumbha.summary: Triumph over challenges through disciplined routine and dedicated effort.
Kumbha.general: The 6th house Moon sharpens your problem-solving skills and competitive edge. Methodical application will clear backlogs and establish peaceful order.
Kumbha.career: You outshine competitors through diligent execution and attention to granular details. Subordinates and team members will be supportive and collaborative.
Kumbha.finance: Favorable indications for resolving debts and recovering pending payments. Maintain a conservative approach toward unvetted credit obligations.
Kumbha.relationships: Avoid turning minor domestic differences into debates over trivial matters. Express appreciation for your partner's everyday acts of care and service.
Kumbha.health: Vitality is steady, but avoid irregular meal timings to prevent acidity. Incorporate regular stretching to relieve abdominal and lower back tension.
Kumbha.remedy: Feed stray dogs or birds with unsalted bread or grains.

Meena.summary: Artistic inspiration, romance, and joyful intellect flourish vibrantly.
Meena.general: The Moon in your fifth house awakens joyful self-expression, creativity, and spiritual intuition. Your ideas resonate with natural charm and authentic warmth.
Meena.career: Innovative solutions, educational projects, and design work get major breakthroughs. Your creative concepts will be warmly received by your superiors.
Meena.finance: Promising prospects in speculative intelligence, creative assets, and prudent investments. Trust your well-researched financial instincts today.
Meena.relationships: Romance sparkles with sweet surprises, heartfelt warmth, and playful banter. Delightful time spent with children or creative hobbies brings genuine joy.
Meena.health: Your mind is vibrant and energy levels remain high and cheerful. Enhance your vitality through uplifting music and light breathing exercises.
Meena.remedy: Recite the Gayatri Mantra 24 times facing the east in the morning.

tithi.name: Shashthi
tithi.description: Dedicated to Lord Kartikeya, ideal for cultivating discipline, courage, and resolving lingering disputes.

Mesha.summary: Enhanced courage and decisive action open fresh doors for collaborative progress.
Mesha.general: The Moon's movement through your 3rd house inspires active communication and vibrant motivation today. Your proactive approach helps dismantle minor hurdles that slowed down your momentum recently.
Mesha.career: Initiatives involving networking, media, or pitch presentations will yield favorable reception. Collegial support will be strong, enabling swift execution of pending assignments.
Mesha.finance: Financial prospects remain steady with possibilities of minor gains through short travels or contractual work. Avoid speculative investments and maintain a disciplined savings habit.
Mesha.relationships: Bonds with younger siblings and close peers bring warm comfort and practical advice. Openhearted conversations will resolve previous domestic misunderstandings effortlessly.
Mesha.health: Vitality is elevated, though minor shoulder or upper-respiratory stiffness may arise from exertion. Incorporate mild stretching and pranayama into your morning routine.
Mesha.remedy: Chant the Hanuman Chalisa and offer jaggery to birds.

Vrishabha.summary: Focus shifts to family stability, financial consolidation, and thoughtful communication.
Vrishabha.general: A stabilizing second-house lunar transit centers your thoughts on security and material order. Your spoken words carry influence today, making it crucial to communicate with grace.
Vrishabha.career: Financial strategizing and resource reallocation will proceed smoothly in your professional domain. Colleagues will look to your dependable, grounded approach to settle complex tasks.
Vrishabha.finance: Wealth accumulation efforts gain traction through disciplined budgeting and recovered dues. Keep family expenditure balanced by prioritizing necessities over luxury cravings.
Vrishabha.relationships: A harmonious family atmosphere allows you to enjoy heartfelt conversations and shared meals. Express your appreciation openly to strengthen domestic tranquility.
Vrishabha.health: Pay attention to oral hygiene and throat comfort by avoiding extremely cold beverages. Practicing mindful, unhurried eating will support optimal digestion.
Vrishabha.remedy: Apply a white sandalwood tilak to your forehead after your morning prayer.

Mithuna.summary: Emotional renewal and mental clarity empower personal leadership and creative pursuits.
Mithuna.general: With the Moon illuminating your Janma Rashi under benevolent Punarvasu, an optimistic outlook prevails. You will feel internally refreshed and ready to steer personal ambitions toward fruition.
Mithuna.career: Your ideas will be persuasive, helping you lead team discussions and brainstorm innovative solutions. Focus on executing one priority at a time to prevent mental diffusion.
Mithuna.finance: Financial intuition is sharp, assisting you in making prudent daily budget decisions. Consider allocating a portion of your funds toward educational resources or skill refinement.
Mithuna.relationships: Your magnetic persona attracts warmth and affectionate attention from loved ones. Singles may encounter intellectually engaging connections that spark mutual curiosity.
Mithuna.health: Mental agility is high, but ensure adequate hydration to counter mild restlessness. Engaging in quiet reading or meditation before bedtime will ensure restorative sleep.
Mithuna.remedy: Water a Tulsi plant and chant 'Om Budhaya Namaha' 21 times.

Karka.summary: Quiet contemplation and conscious expenditure restore equilibrium to your busy routine.
Karka.general: The Moon moving through your 12th house urges you to slow down, reflect, and recharge your inner batteries. Steering clear of external chaos will help you regain emotional balance.
Karka.career: Focus primarily on solitary tasks, research, or wrapping up backlogged documentation today. Avoid initiating contentious negotiations, as patience is your greatest strategic ally.
Karka.finance: Unplanned expenses regarding healthcare, travel, or household maintenance may require attention. Scrutinize all outgoing funds carefully and avoid impulsive online retail therapy.
Karka.relationships: You may crave solitude or gentle understanding from your closest companions today. Communicate your need for quiet space diplomatically to avoid accidental friction.
Karka.health: Guard against sleep disturbances and eye strain caused by prolonged screen exposure. Dedicate time to soothing relaxation techniques and light evening strolls.
Karka.remedy: Offer raw milk and water to a Shiva Lingam while chanting 'Om Namah Shivaya'.

Simha.summary: Social alliances flourish and long-cherished ambitions receive auspicious support.
Simha.general: The Moon traversing your 11th house activates gains, fruitful interactions, and community warmth. Your natural charisma will draw inspiring mentors and supportive allies into your sphere.
Simha.career: Collaborative ventures and group presentations will yield remarkably positive outcomes. Your capacity to unite divergent opinions will be noticed and praised by senior peers.
Simha.finance: Financial inflows or overdue payments are likely to materialize, boosting your monetary confidence. It is a propitious day to draft long-term investment strategies with professional advice.
Simha.relationships: Social gatherings or friendly reunions will lift your spirits and spark heartwarming joy. Romance flourishes through shared values and collective aspirations with your partner.
Simha.health: Energy levels remain robust and sustained throughout the day's commitments. Channel this vitality into outdoor physical exercises or brisk recreational walking.
Simha.remedy: Offer water mixed with red flowers to the rising Sun.

Kanya.summary: Professional diligence brings authoritative recognition and rewarding task completion.
Kanya.general: A commanding 10th house transit highlights your vocational competence and problem-solving prowess. Your methodical precision will enable you to handle complex duties with remarkable ease.
Kanya.career: Supervisors will appreciate your timely execution and clear communication in critical projects. Those seeking new job prospects or leadership responsibilities will discover encouraging signals.
Kanya.finance: Steady career gains translate into a secure monetary footing and favorable budget outlooks. Focus on strategic reinvestment rather than frivolous consumer spending.
Kanya.relationships: Professional commitments may consume substantial hours, requiring you to balance home life consciously. A sincere, affectionate gesture in the evening will reassure your loved ones.
Kanya.health: Physical stamina is dependable, but posture-related back tightness could manifest. Take regular breaks from your desk to stretch and maintain ergonomic posture.
Kanya.remedy: Feed green grass or fresh spinach to a cow.

Tula.summary: Higher learning, philosophical clarity, and auspicious fortune expand your horizons.
Tula.general: Fortune smiles as the Moon graces your 9th house, dissolving obstacles and broadening your wisdom. A renewed sense of spiritual peace and optimism will guide your actions today.
Tula.career: Tasks involving publishing, legal matters, or cross-border coordination progress pleasantly. Guidance received from an experienced mentor will offer invaluable direction for your growth.
Tula.finance: Financial prospects remain auspicious, with chances of rewarding returns on past undertakings. Philanthropic donations or spiritual expenditures will bring deep internal satisfaction.
Tula.relationships: Philosophical alignment and shared ideals elevate your romantic and familial bonds. Meaningful conversations will bring profound harmony and mutual understanding.
Tula.health: Well-being is well-balanced, supported by an unburdened and optimistic mental state. Nourish your body with wholesome, freshly prepared satvik meals.
Tula.remedy: Light a pure ghee lamp under a Peepal tree or near your altar.

Vrischika.summary: Inward transformation and patient discretion help you navigate subtle emotional undercurrents.
Vrischika.general: The Moon traveling through the 8th house suggests adopting a discreet, observant, and reflective posture today. Channel your intuition toward research, problem investigation, and inner healing.
Vrischika.career: Handle sensitive workplace data with confidentiality and avoid entering speculative discussions. Diligent adherence to standard procedures will protect you against unexpected delays.
Vrischika.finance: Avoid entering new debt obligations, lending money, or signing unverified financial documents. Review insurance, joint assets, or tax liabilities to keep everything in strict order.
Vrischika.relationships: Intense feelings might surface, making it essential to communicate with restraint and empathy. Give your partner the benefit of the doubt to prevent unnecessary misunderstandings.
Vrischika.health: Watch out for seasonal allergies, sluggish digestion, or unaddressed fatigue. Prioritize adequate hydration, warm herbal teas, and early evening rest.
Vrischika.remedy: Recite the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra 11 times with devotion.

Dhanu.summary: Collaborative synergy and warm relational reciprocity make this a deeply rewarding day.
Dhanu.general: With the Moon activating your 7th house, interpersonal dynamics take center stage with wonderful promise. Your charm and willingness to compromise will foster mutual respect in all dealings.
Dhanu.career: Business partnerships and client negotiations find productive, harmonious common ground. Joint projects proceed smoothly as everyone aligns around a unified vision.
Dhanu.finance: Monetary prospects are favorable, particularly through collective ventures and commercial contracts. Balance current expenditure by setting aside funds for future collaborative projects.
Dhanu.relationships: Spousal harmony is heightened, making it a wonderful evening for a romantic date or heartfelt sharing. Unmarried natives may receive delightful news regarding alliance discussions.
Dhanu.health: Vitality is sound, provided you maintain a steady balance between work and relaxation. Drinking adequate water throughout the day will maintain optimal kidney and skin health.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a saffron or turmeric tilak and respect your teachers or elders.

Makara.summary: Systematic effort and competitive drive allow you to resolve pending bottlenecks cleanly.
Makara.general: The Moon occupying your 6th house provides the practical resolve needed to overcome daily obstacles. Your focus on quality control and orderly execution will turn challenges into victories.
Makara.career: You will outshine competitors through persistent, meticulous labor and superior organization. Complex operational issues will be resolved swiftly under your direct guidance.
Makara.finance: Monetary management remains stable, with opportunities to curb wasteful recurring expenditures. It is a good time to settle lingering bills and maintain tight budget control.
Makara.relationships: Keep discussions with family members constructive and steer clear of overly critical remarks. Showing practical care through helpful actions will deepen emotional bonds.
Makara.health: Energy is high, but digestive sensitivity could flare up if you consume heavy, greasy foods. Incorporate fiber-rich meals and practice brisk walking after meals.
Makara.remedy: Light a mustard oil lamp in front of Lord Shani or a Shami plant in the evening.

Kumbha.summary: Creative inspiration and joyful intellect spark delightful breakthroughs in your projects.
Kumbha.general: The 5th house lunar transit kindles intellect, artistic expression, and joyous entertainment. Your problem-solving skills will be remarkably sharp and out-of-the-box today.
Kumbha.career: Creative ventures, analytical studies, and strategic presentations will receive notable appreciation. Trust your original ideas, as they will inspire your peers to innovate along with you.
Kumbha.finance: Prudent financial planning will yield stability, though speculative gambles should be approached cautiously. Budgeting for hobbies or your children's educational needs will bring joy.
Kumbha.relationships: Warmth, playfulness, and romance blossom naturally in your personal life. Spending quality time with children or engaging in shared creative hobbies enriches your soul.
Kumbha.health: Emotional cheerfulness reflects positively on your overall physical stamina. Maintain this uplifting state through light recreational activities and mindful breathing.
Kumbha.remedy: Feed soaked black chana or grains to birds in the morning.

Meena.summary: Cultivating domestic tranquility and emotional grounding restores your inner sanctuary.
Meena.general: The 4th house lunar passage draws your attention to domestic comfort, home affairs, and peace of mind. Taking time to organize your personal space will alleviate subtle background stress.
Meena.career: You may prefer handling tasks that demand concentration over hectic public engagements. Maintaining a calm and composed demeanor will help diffuse workplace urgency.
Meena.finance: Expenses regarding home improvements, real estate upkeep, or vehicle care may arise. Make financial choices thoughtfully, ensuring they enhance family convenience long term.
Meena.relationships: Spend gentle moments listening to your mother or maternal elders for valuable guidance. Open, soothing interactions will help reinforce emotional safety within the household.
Meena.health: Be mindful of chest congestion, seasonal coughs, or emotional fatigue. Drink warm water and practice deep diaphragmatic breathing to release built-up tension.
Meena.remedy: Chant the Gayatri Mantra 24 times and offer water to a Peepal tree (without touching it on Saturday).
